item.description:
A welcome tour. AgentDock now introduces itself: it checks your cmux connection live (and tells you exactly what to change if cmux won't let it in), explains the dots, the Inbox and ⌥⌥, and lets you pick a look. Reopen it any time from the menu bar › Welcome Tour…

Make the panels yours (Settings › Look):

  • Appearance: light or dark panels, whatever your system uses.
  • Background: from clear glass to fully solid, for a calmer, more readable card.
  • Rows: Tiles, a tidy List, or Compact single lines.

Also: details now line up under each agent's name.

Fixed: answering a Codex question from the Inbox now works. Before, the answer was sent but the question came straight back, because AgentDock misread Codex's reply as a new question.

Clearer hover card: each agent sits on its own tile, and agents waiting on you are tinted amber.

Also in this update (from 0.4.2):

  • Codex questions: when Codex asks something while it keeps working, its dot turns amber and the question appears in the Inbox. Answer with 1–9, like Claude's questions.
  • Settings (⌘,) with a live preview: choose what the hover card shows and when idle agents fold away.
  • A richer, compact hover card: model, live turn timers, optional tokens and today's usage. It fits its content.

Codex questions. When Codex asks something while it keeps working, its dot turns amber and the question appears in the Inbox. Answer it with 1–9, just like Claude's questions.

  • Settings (⌘,) with a live preview: choose what the hover card shows (model, turn timer, tokens, today's usage) and when idle agents fold away.
  • A richer hover card: model, live turn timers, tokens and context, and a Today chart of Claude and Codex usage. Tokens and usage are off by default.
  • A compact card: it now fits its content instead of a fixed width.
  • Smarter titles: Codex's temporary "Action Required" title no longer replaces the real one.
  • Lighter: session files are read only while something on screen uses them.
